gizmo.title: Umdlalo wenkumbulo
gizmo.description: Phenya amakhadi ukuze uthole amapheya. Faniselanisa igama nencazelo yalo ukuze ukufana kubonise ukuqonda, noma usebenzise imibhalo emibili noma izithombe ezimbili ezifanayo.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Umyalelo oboniswa esihlokweni, isibonelo: Faniselanisa igama nomsebenzi walo.

configure.title: Amapheya
configure.description: Ipheya ngalinye lingamakhadi amabili ahambisanayo, ngokuvamile igama nencazelo yalo. Uhlangothi ludinga umbhalo, isithombe, noma kokubili.

advanced.title: Umbala wokugcizelela
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa we-chip yesihloko, ingemuva lamakhadi nenkinobho.
